name: household and enrollment test report
query:
SELECT 
    hf.name, hf.landmark, hf.date_of_visit, hf.hamlet, hf.respondent_name, 
    hf.hosuehold_head_name, hf.respondent_age, hf.is_the_family_a_pvtg, 
    hf.primary_occupation, hf.pvtg_name, hf.primary_occupation_other, 
    hf.number_of_family_members, hf.children_6_to_18_years, hf.adults_above_18_years, 
    hf.is_anyone_of_your_family_a_migrant_worker, hf.family_members_enganged_as_migrant_workers, 
    hf.no_of_months_the_migrants_were_away_last_year, hf.does_anyone_from_your_family_migrate_every_year, 
    hf.do_you_take_your_children_along_with_you, hf.who_looks_after_them_at_home, hf.remarks, 
    hf.social_category_id, hf.verfication_status, hf.primary_occupation_id, 
    hf.app_created_by, hf.children__3_years, hf.children_3_to_6_years, hf.verification_status, 
    hf.workflow_state, hf.hhid, hf.religion, hf.any_other_religion, hf.creche_id, hf.no_of_pregnant_women, 
    hf.whether_the_household_migrated_from_settlementvillage, 
    hf.phone_no, hf.hh_id_janadhikara, hf.which_is_your_native_state, hf.which_is_your_native_district,
    -- Child form fields
    hcf.name AS child_form_name, hcf.parent AS child_parent, hcf.child_name, hcf.child_age, 
    hcf.is_dob_available, hcf.child_dob, hcf.relationship_with_child, hcf.hhguid AS child_hhguid, 
    hcf.hhcguid, hcf.relation_with_child_other, 
    hcf.any_other_gender AS child_any_other_gender, hcf.mother_tongue,
    CASE 
        WHEN hf.respondent_gender_id = 1 THEN 'Male'
        WHEN hf.respondent_gender_id = 2 THEN 'Female'
        WHEN hf.respondent_gender_id = 3 THEN 'Other'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS respondent_gender,

    
    CASE 
        WHEN hcf.gender_id = 1 THEN 'Male'
        WHEN hcf.gender_id = 2 THEN 'Female'
        WHEN hcf.gender_id = 3 THEN 'Other'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS child_gender,
        
        

    r.religion AS religion_name,
    sc.social_category_name,
    po.primary_occupation AS primary_occupation_name,
    nm.no_of_months,
    yn.option_name AS migration_status,
    cg.gender AS child_gender,
    cr.creche_name AS "Creche",
    g.gp_name AS "GP",
    b.block_name AS "Block",
    d.district_name AS "District",
    s.state_name AS "State",
    p.partner_name AS "Partner",

    cee.creche_id,
    cee.child_id,
    cee.child_name,
    cee.date_of_enrollment,
    cee.child_dob,
    cee.age_at_enrollment_in_months,
    cee.height,
    cee.weight,
    cee.date_of_exit,
    cee.age_of_exit,
    cee.other_reason,
    cee.is_child_enrolled_awc,
    cee.date_of_enrollment_awc,
    cee.is_active,
    cee.is_exited,
    cee.measurement_taken,
    CASE 
        WHEN cee.measurement_equipment = 1 THEN 'Stadiometer'
        ELSE 'Infantometer'
    END AS measurement_equipment,
    
    CASE 
        WHEN cee.measurement_equipment_exit = 1 THEN 'Stadiometer'
        ELSE 'Infantometer'
    END AS measurement_equipment_exit,
    cee.weight_for_age,
    cee.weight_for_height,
    cee.height_for_age,
    cee.measurement_date,
    cee.weight_for_age_zscore,
    cee.weight_for_height_zscore,
    cee.height_for_age_zscore,
    cee.height_exit,
    cee.weight_exit,
    cee.measurement_equipment_exit,
    cee.weight_for_age_zscore_exit,
    cee.weight_for_height_zscore_exit,
    cee.height_for_age_zscore_exit,
    cee.weight_for_age_exit,
    cee.weight_for_height_exit,
    cee.height_for_age_exit,
    rfe.add_reasons as 'reason for exit',
    
    
    cp.currently_brestfeeding,
    cp.does_child_have_any_disability,
    cp.does_child_have_any_longterm_illness_more_than_6_months,
    cp.how_many_siblings_does_the_child_have,
    cp.name_of_primary_caregiver,
    cp.birth_order_of_the_child,
    cp.family_lives_in,
    ht.house_type,
    sw.source as 'source of water',
    cp.do_they_migrate_for_work,
    cp.land_available_for_cultivation,
    el.level as "education level of parentscaregiver",
    cp.entitlement_received_by_the_family_at_present,
    cp.is_the_child_enrolled_for_take_home_ration,
    cp.entitlement_any_other,
    cp.any_other_specify_illness,
    cp.is_active,
    rl.relation_name as 'relation with child',
    cp.father_name,
    cp.mother_name,
    cp.child_specially_abled,
    cp.entitlement_received_id,
    cp.status,
    cp.remarks,
    cp.verification_date

    
FROM `tabHousehold Form` AS hf
inner JOIN `tabHousehold Child Form` AS hcf ON hf.name = hcf.parent
LEFT JOIN `tabCreche` AS cr ON cr.name = hf.creche_id
LEFT JOIN `tabReligion` AS r ON r.name = hf.religion
LEFT JOIN `tabSocial Category` AS sc ON sc.name = hf.social_category_id
LEFT JOIN `tabPrimary Occupation` AS po ON po.name = hf.primary_occupation_id
LEFT JOIN `tabNo of Months` AS nm ON nm.name = hf.no_of_months_the_migrants_were_away_last_year
LEFT JOIN `tabYesNo` AS yn ON yn.name = hf.whether_the_household_migrated_from_settlementvillage
LEFT JOIN `tabGender` AS cg ON cg.name = hcf.gender_id
LEFT JOIN `tabChild Enrollment and Exit` AS cee ON cee.hhcguid = hcf.hhcguid
LEFT JOIN `tabReason for child exit` AS rfe ON cee.reason_for_exit = rfe.seq_id
LEFT JOIN `tabChild Profile` AS cp ON hcf.hhcguid = cp.chhguid
LEFT JOIN `tabLanguage Master` AS lm ON hcf.mother_tongue = lm.seq_id
LEFT JOIN `tabHouse Type` AS ht ON cp.type_of_house = ht.seq_id
LEFT JOIN `tabSource of Water` AS sw ON cp.source_of_drinking_water_in_the_household = sw.seq_id
LEFT JOIN `tabEducation Level` AS el ON cp.education_level_of_parentscaregiver = el.seq_id
LEFT JOIN `tabRelation` AS rl ON cp.relationship_with_child = rl.seq_id

INNER JOIN `tabPartner` p ON p.name = cr.partner_id
INNER JOIN `tabState` s ON s.name = cr.state_id
INNER JOIN `tabDistrict` d ON d.name = cr.district_id
INNER JOIN `tabBlock` b ON b.name = cr.block_id
INNER JOIN `tabGram Panchayat` g ON g.name = cr.gp_id

;
